subject: Covariate increases AIC (+2) but appears to improve precision of D

messages.author: ffb0921830fd2802
messages.subject: Covariate increases AIC (+2) but appears to improve precision of D
parts:
I have a couple of instances where adding a covariate increases AIC by ex=
actly 2 but gives much greater precision on D (CV~12% compared with 24% f=
rom the base model with no covariates). This result seems unlikely and I =
wonder if it could be the result of different variance calculation with M=
CDS compared with CDS. The covariate adds a single parameter which has ve=
ry poor precision.

One reason I care about this is that I want to manually model-average D. =
I would consider this covariate to be a 'pretending variable' and discard=
this model prior to model-averaging, but the change in precision has me =
worried.

I would be grateful for any insights on why this happens and what it mean=
s.

If people would like to reply directly to wil...@landcareresearch.co.nz =
I will collate any replies and post them to the list.

Many thanks
Deb
